OUR FAITH

Handmade, held in faith

Jewels by Betsa was born in a bedroom, in the mind of a teenager who longed to bring the faith to others in some way. So I make every rosary, bracelet, keychain and decade with so much love; each one goes through its own time of prayer, so that when it reaches your hands it is ready for you to pray and carry your faith with you always.

Betsa hopes every piece helps us all to pray, to keep our faith always with us, and to remember how loved we are by our Father, how Mary always leads us to Him, and that our path to holiness has light despite the difficulties we meet along the way, because it is guided by Jesus, Mary and Joseph ❤️
